sections.skill: Understand what grants are and their limits

questions.prompt: What is a grant?

choices.text: Money for specific purposes that is not repaid
A loan with a very low interest rate from a bank
An investment that buys part of the business
A tax that small businesses must pay each year

questions.correct_answer: Money for specific purposes that is not repaid
questions.intro: A GRANT is money that does not have to be repaid, usually from a government agency, foundation or company, for specific purposes. Grants for starting a general small business are less common than many people think; many target research, specific industries, places or groups. Applications take time, have deadlines and rules about how money is spent, and may require reports. Be wary of offers that charge a fee to "guarantee" a grant. Free help finding real programs is available from SBDCs and similar organizations.
